name: GPT-5 Nano
short: OpenAI's ultra-compact tier (400K/128K, $0.05/$0.40) for high-volume classification and extraction; AIME 2025 85.2%, SWE-bench Verified 54.7% - superseded by GPT-5.4 nano.
standout: The price floor of the frontier family: $0.05/M in and $0.40/M out for a 400K-context reasoning model.
tradeoff: Agentic work is out of reach (tau2 telecom 35.5%, Terminal-Bench Hard 12.1%) and GPT-5.4 nano beats it on both price-per-capability and axis scores.
